duplicateReport: a step may call todo_report exactly once.
lateReport: todo_report must precede the other tool calls in the same step.
noActiveTask: no main task is in progress. Create and start one, then retry this step with todo_report before the other tool calls.
budgetExhausted: todo coverage budget is exhausted. Report the active task with todo_report before the other tool calls, then retry this step.

coverageWarning.one: Todo coverage warning: this step has no successful todo_report. {{granted}} exempt step is granted for this round ({{remaining}} remaining); report within them to reset the budget. The step continues the last recorded report.
coverageWarning.many: Todo coverage warning: this step has no successful todo_report. {{granted}} exempt steps are granted for this round ({{remaining}} remaining); report within them to reset the budget. The step continues the last recorded report.
